combo1.title: One Magician's Rod: Full Backrow (2026)
combo1.description: A one-card line from a single Normal Summon of Magician's Rod, built on the Pharaoh's Servant wave. Rod searches Dark Magical Curtain, Curtain brings out Dark Magician and adds Soul Servant, and that Dark Magician becomes Dark Magician of Destruction, which searches Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant. The Servant Sets Magician's Salvation, Salvation Sets Eternal Soul, and Soul Servant draws you Magicians' Souls, which revives Dark Magician Girl so Salvation can bring the Servant back. You end with Dark Magician of Destruction, Miasma Necromancer, Dark Magician Girl and the Servant, with Salvation active and Eternal Soul Set.

steps.text: Normal Summon Magician's Rod
Activate effect: Magician's Rod was Normal Summoned, so it adds 1 Spell/Trap that lists "Dark Magician" from your Deck to your hand
Dark Magical Curtain is added from your Deck to your hand
Activate Dark Magical Curtain
Curtain resolves: each player can Special Summon 1 DARK Spellcaster from their hand or Deck, and you Special Summon Dark Magician from your Deck
You Special Summoned an original "Dark Magician", so Curtain adds Soul Servant from your Deck to your hand
Dark Magical Curtain goes to the GY
A Spell was activated this turn, so you can banish Dark Magician, a Level 7 DARK Spellcaster you control, as material for Dark Magician of Destruction
Special Summon Dark Magician of Destruction from your Extra Deck to a Main Monster Zone, keeping the Extra Monster Zone free for the Link
Activate effect: Dark Magician of Destruction was Special Summoned, so it adds "Dark Magician" or a card that mentions it from your Deck to your hand
Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant is added from your Deck to your hand
Activate effect: Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant reveals Soul Servant, a Spell in your hand
Special Summon Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant from your hand; its name is "Dark Magician" on the field and in the GY
The Servant Sets Magician's Salvation from your Deck in the Field Zone
Activate the Set Magician's Salvation (a Field Spell can be activated the turn it was Set)
Salvation's activation Sets Eternal Soul directly from your Deck
Activate Soul Servant from your hand
Soul Servant places Magicians' Souls, a card that mentions "Dark Magician", from your Deck on top of your Deck
Soul Servant goes to the GY
Banish Soul Servant from your GY to draw 1 card: "Dark Magician" is the only qualifying name on the field and in the GYs
Draw Magicians' Souls
Magician's Rod goes to the GY as material for Miasma Necromancer
Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant goes to the GY as material too, where its name is "Dark Magician"
Link Summon Miasma Necromancer (2 monsters, including a DARK Spellcaster) to the Extra Monster Zone
Activate effect: Magicians' Souls in your hand sends 1 Level 6 or higher Spellcaster from your Deck to the GY
Dark Magician Girl is sent from your Deck to the GY
Magicians' Souls sends itself to the GY
Special Summon Dark Magician Girl from your GY
Activate effect: Magician's Salvation targets Dark Magician Girl, which you just Special Summoned, to Special Summon a "Dark Magician" with a different name from your GY

Special Summon Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant from your GY. End board: Dark Magician of Destruction, Miasma Necromancer, Dark Magician Girl and the Servant, Salvation active and Eternal Soul Set

combo2.title: Illusion of Chaos into Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon
combo2.description: A two-card line from Illusion of Chaos and Dark Magical Circle that leaves The Gaze of Timaeus Set for your opponent's turn. Illusion of Chaos finds Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant, which reveals Circle to Special Summon itself and Set Gaze from the Deck. Activating Circle lets you banish the Servant for Dark Magician of Destruction, which searches Eternal Soul. On your opponent's turn, Gaze shuffles Destruction back into the Extra Deck to Fusion Summon Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon, which stays until the End Phase of your next turn.

steps.text: Activate effect: reveal Illusion of Chaos in your hand to add "Dark Magician" or a non-Ritual monster that mentions it from your Deck to your hand
Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant is added from your Deck to your hand
Illusion of Chaos then places 1 card from your hand on top of your Deck: you put Illusion of Chaos itself back
Activate effect: Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant reveals Dark Magical Circle, a Spell in your hand
Special Summon Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant from your hand
The Servant Sets The Gaze of Timaeus from your Deck. It is a Quick-Play Spell, so it can't be activated until your opponent's turn
Activate Dark Magical Circle
Circle resolves: look at the top 3 cards of your Deck, add "Dark Magician" or a Spell/Trap that mentions it if one is there, and put the rest back in any order
A Spell was activated this turn, so you can banish the Servant, a Level 7 DARK Spellcaster you control, as material for Dark Magician of Destruction
Special Summon Dark Magician of Destruction from your Extra Deck. Its name is "Dark Magician" on the field, so Circle could banish a card your opponent controls here when you go second
Activate effect: Dark Magician of Destruction was Special Summoned, so it adds "Dark Magician" or a card that mentions it from your Deck to your hand
Eternal Soul is added from your Deck to your hand
Set Eternal Soul, then end your turn
Your opponent's turn: activate The Gaze of Timaeus, targeting Dark Magician of Destruction (its name is "Dark Magician" on the field)
Dark Magician of Destruction is shuffled back into your Extra Deck as the only Fusion Material
Fusion Summon Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon. Its negate is live; its destroy effect isn't, because no Normal Monster was used as material. It is banished in the End Phase of your next turn
The Gaze of Timaeus goes to the GY

combo3.title: Going Second: Rod and Souls Banish a Card
combo3.description: A two-card answer to a set-up board from Magician's Rod and Magicians' Souls. Rod searches Dark Magical Circle, and Magicians' Souls sends Dark Magician from the Deck to the GY and revives it, so Circle's summon trigger banishes a card your opponent controls. The banish targets, but it isn't destruction, so it gets past cards that can't be destroyed.

steps.text: Normal Summon Magician's Rod
Activate effect: Magician's Rod was Normal Summoned, so it adds 1 Spell/Trap that lists "Dark Magician" from your Deck to your hand
Dark Magical Circle is added from your Deck to your hand
Activate Dark Magical Circle
Circle resolves: look at the top 3 cards of your Deck, add "Dark Magician" or a Spell/Trap that mentions it if one is there, and put the rest back in any order
Activate effect: Magicians' Souls in your hand sends 1 Level 6 or higher Spellcaster from your Deck to the GY
Dark Magician is sent from your Deck to the GY
Magicians' Souls sends itself to the GY
Special Summon Dark Magician from your GY
Activate effect: Dark Magician was Special Summoned, so Dark Magical Circle targets 1 card your opponent controls and banishes it
